Windows supports Light and Dark themes as a personalization option in Windows settings.
There are many approaches to implementing Dark mode support in an application. Some apps contain two sets of UIs (one with a light color and one with a dark color). Some Windows UI frameworks, such as WinUI 3 , automatically detect a system's theme and adjust the UI to follow the system theme.
* Know when Dark mode is enabled
Knowing when Dark mode is enabled in the system settings can help you know when to switch your app UI to a Dark mode-themed UI.
* Enable a Dark mode title bar for Win32 applications
Not all Win32 applications support Dark mode, so Windows gives Win32 apps a light title bar by default.
If you are prepared to support Dark mode, you can ask Windows to draw the dark title bar instead when Dark mode is enabled.
Note
This article provides examples of ways to detect system theme changes, and request a light or dark title bar for your Win32 application's window.

Design decision for wine behavior: When dark mode is enabled for the window:
1. Send `WM_UAHINITMENU` (0x93) to the window (wParam=0, lParam=0).
2. Send `WM_UAHDRAWMENU` (0x91) with lParam = &UAHMENU{hmenu=handle, hdc=hdc, flags}. If the app handles it (paints the bar), we must NOT do our own `fill_rect` background + bottom line, and we must skip `draw_menu_item` for each item and instead send `WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM`.
3. For each item, send `WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM` (0x92) with lParam = &UAHDRAWMENUITEM.
4. Sizing: send `WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM` (0x94) during `calc_menu_bar_size` for each item so the app can set width/height.

How to decide whether the app "handled" it? Windows semantics: For dark-enabled windows, user32 sends WM_UAHDRAWMENU; the app's window proc handles it. But if the app doesn't handle it, Windows must still draw something. In practice, on Windows the messages are sent to windows that opted into dark mode AND the app is expected to handle them (it's their dark-mode implementation). DefWindowProc's handling of WM_UAHDRAWMENU: per UAHMenuBar.h comment, only WM_UAHINITMENU and WM_UAHNCPAINTMENUPOPUP are "handled by DefWindowProc", implying WM_UAHDRAWMENU/ITEM are *not* handled by DefWindowProc (return 0 without drawing). # STATE — Wine patches to make Notepad++ dark mode run like Windows

Last updated: 2026-10-04 (session 1)
Working dir: /home/asdf/projects/npp-darkmode-wine

## MISSION
Make Notepad++ dark mode (esp. menu bar) work under Wine exactly as on Windows,
by producing Wine patches (uxtheme + win32u). Verify against a Windows VM.
Do NOT submit upstream (LLM rule). Working dir must contain ALL patches used;
app-exclusive patches go in `patches/app-specific/npp/`.

## BUG
Wine bug 57555 ("Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark mode is not fully applied", UNCONFIRMED).
Wine 10.0-rc2 report. Repro: NPP > Settings > Preferences > Dark Mode > "Dark mode".
Menu bar stays light (pure #FFFFFF) while editor/toolbar go dark.

## REPRODUCED (session 1)
- NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64 (latest 2026-09-24) + Wine 11.18 Staging (/opt/wine-staging).
- Pixel proof: menu row (255,255,255) in BOTH light and dark; toolbar/editor (32,32,32)/(63,63,63).
- Artifacts: shot_final_dark.png, compare_light_vs_dark.png, shot_prefs_dark.png,
  probe.c/.exe, src/, menu.c (upstream 11.18 win32u/menu.c), bug-57555.xml.

## ROOT CAUSE (evidence-backed)
- NPP darkens the menu bar ONLY via the undocumented UAH protocol:
  wndproc subclass handles WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x0091) / WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x0092)
  (src/NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210, UAHMenuBar.h; structs UAHMENU/UAHDRAWMENUITEM/

"""Tiny HTTP file channel for the Windows guest.

Host side: serves <share>/ for GET and stores PUT bodies in <share>/.
Guest side: curl http://192.168.122.1:8000/<name>   and   curl -T <file> http://192.168.122.1:8000/<name>

usage: vmserv.py [port] [share_dir]
"""
import http.server
import os
import socketserver
import sys

PORT = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 8000
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
SHARE = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else os.path.join(ROOT, "vmshare")
os.makedirs(SHARE, exist_ok=True)


class Handler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def __init__(self, *a, **kw):
        super().__init__(*a, directory=SHARE, **kw)

"""Tiny HTTP file channel for the Windows guest.

Host side: serves <share>/ for GET and stores PUT bodies in <share>/.
Guest side: curl http://192.168.122.1:8000/<name>   and   curl -T <file> http://192.168.122.1:8000/<name>

usage: vmserv.py [port] [share_dir]
"""
import http.server
import os
import socketserver
import sys

PORT = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 8000
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
SHARE = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else os.path.join(ROOT, "vmshare")
os.makedirs(SHARE, exist_ok=True)


class Handler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def __init__(self, *a, **kw):
        super().__init__(*a, directory=SHARE, **kw)

    def do_PUT(self):
        name = os.path.basename(self.path.split("?")[0])
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        data = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        with open(os.path.join(SHARE, name), "wb") as f:

        self.end_headers()

            listing = "\n".join(sorted(os.listdir(SHARE))) + "\n"
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(listing)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(listing.encode())
            return
        super().do_GET()

        sys.stderr.write("%s - %s\n" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args))
        sys.stderr.flush()


class Server(socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer):

    daemon_threads = True

# STATE — Wine patches to make Notepad++ dark mode run like Windows

Last updated: 2026-10-04 (session 1)
Working dir: /home/asdf/projects/npp-darkmode-wine

## MISSION
Make Notepad++ dark mode (esp. menu bar) work under Wine exactly as on Windows,
by producing Wine patches (uxtheme + win32u). Verify against a Windows VM.
Do NOT submit upstream (LLM rule). Working dir must contain ALL patches used;
app-exclusive patches go in `patches/app-specific/npp/`.

## BUG
Wine bug 57555 ("Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark mode is not fully applied", UNCONFIRMED).
Wine 10.0-rc2 report. Repro: NPP > Settings > Preferences > Dark Mode > "Dark mode".
Menu bar stays light (pure #FFFFFF) while editor/toolbar go dark.

## REPRODUCED (session 1)
- NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64 (latest 2026-09-24) + Wine 11.18 Staging (/opt/wine-staging).
- Pixel proof: menu row (255,255,255) in BOTH light and dark; toolbar/editor (32,32,32)/(63,63,63).
- Artifacts: shot_final_dark.png, compare_light_vs_dark.png, shot_prefs_dark.png,
  probe.c/.exe, src/, menu.c (upstream 11.18 win32u/menu.c), bug-57555.xml.

## ROOT CAUSE (evidence-backed)
- NPP darkens the menu bar ONLY via the undocumented UAH protocol:
  wndproc subclass handles WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x0091) / WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x0092)
  (src/NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210, UAHMenuBar.h; structs UAHMENU/UAHDRAWMENUITEM/
   UAHMENUITEM/UAHMENUITEMMETRICS).
- NPP enables it via uxtheme ordinals: 133 AllowDarkModeForWindow,
  135 SetPreferredAppMode (>=18362), 136 FlushMenuThemes, 137 IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow,
  104 RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState, 49 OpenNcThemeData  (src/DarkMode.cpp:284-333).
  `AllowDarkModeForApp(allow)` -> SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark=2) (src/DarkMode.cpp:42-75).
  `SetDarkMode()` -> AllowDarkModeForApp(useDark) + FlushMenuThemes().
- Probe under Wine 11.18: all those ordinals resolve (so NPP g_darkModeSupported=TRUE),
  BUT: AllowDarkModeForWindow -> FALSE, IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow -> FALSE,
  SetPreferredAppMode -> 0, and **zero** UAH messages ever delivered.
- Wine 11.18 source: dlls/uxtheme/system.c -> those are `FIXME("stub")`.
  dlls/win32u/menu.c has NO dark/UAH handling; include/winuser.h lacks WM_UAH*.
- Wine reports 10.0 build 19045 (passes NPP's CheckBuildNumber; >=19041 so NPP's
  setDarkTitleBar takes the DwmSetWindowAttribute path, and dark forcing comes from
  SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark)).

## DESIGN (current)
1. win32u: new per-process dark-mode state + entry points:
   NtUserSetPreferredAppMode(int)->prev, NtUserAllowDarkModeForWindow(HWND,BOOL)->BOOL,
   NtUserIsDarkModeAllowedForWindow(HWND)->BOOL, NtUserFlushMenuThemes().
   Mode semantics: Default=0, AllowDark=1, ForceDark=2, ForceLight=3.
   Dark for window = (mode==ForceDark) || (mode==AllowDark && per-window flag).
2. uxtheme/system.c: ordinals 133/135/136/137/104 forward to the win32u functions
   (spec: wire via win32u.NtUser* forwarding).
3. win32u/menu.c NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp(): when dark allowed for hwnd ->
   send WM_UAHINITMENU (0x93); send WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x91) with UAHMENU{hmenu,hdc,flags};
   per item send WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x92) with UAHDRAWMENUITEM{dis,um,umi};
   skip default bar background + default item drawing when app handles it.
   Also WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM (0x94) in calc_menu_bar_size per bar item.
   Layer sizes: UAHMENUITEMMETRICS union rgsizeBar[2]{cx,cy}/rgsizePopup[4]{cx,cy}.
4. Popups (WM_UAHNCPAINTMENUPOPUP 0x95) — phase 2 if needed.

## PATHS / ASSETS
- wine-src/           pristine wine-11.18 (dl.winehq.org tarball), to be patched+built.
- patches/            output patch series (git format-patch style). [to create]
- patches/app-specific/npp/   app-exclusive patches. [to create]
- prefix/             NPP test WINEPREFIX (win64).
- npp/                NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64.
- probe.c/probe.exe   UAH/uxtheme probe harness.
- src/                NPP dark-mode sources (upstream master).
- Xvfb :99            used for NPP runs (started/stopped ad hoc).
- Windows VM: TBD (power on per user instruction).

## NEXT ACTIONS
1. Power on Windows VM; capture baseline (NPP dark mode on real Windows + API trace).
2. Configure+build wine-src (--enable-archs=x86_64), verify NPP bug reproduces on built wine.
3. Implement phases 1-3, rebuild, test on NPP, iterate vs Windows.
4. Package patches + docs; mark app-exclusive ones.

## RULES FROM USER
- Reward over cost; saturate CPU but never OOM (check mem/disk first).
- ~10 or fewer parallel subagents; store state for compaction.
- VNC display for autonomous GUI interaction.
- Use WineHQ wiki building instructions; Wine best practices; no upstream submission.
- If fix is config/fonts not patches -> document reproducible fix.
- If app can't run / can't be licensed due to missing kernel APIs -> document and stop.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run Notepad++ under Wine and report whether dark mode is actually applied.

Checks the menu bar (the bug), the toolbar and the editor background.
Menu bar light on white while the rest is dark == bug 57555 reproduced.
"""
import argparse
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from PIL import Image

WD = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
PREFIX = os.path.join(WD, "prefix")
NPP_CFG = os.path.join(PREFIX, "drive_c/NPP/config.xml")
DISPLAY = ":99"
LIGHTISH = 200  # channel value above which a pixel counts as "light"


def start_xvfb():
    if not os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
        subprocess.Popen(["Xvfb", DISPLAY, "-screen", "0", "1600x1000x24", "-nolisten", "tcp"],
                         stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "xvfb.log"), "wb"),
                         stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        for _ in range(100):
            if os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
                break
            time.sleep(0.1)
    return os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99")


def set_config(mode="dark"):
    """mode: dark | light | follow-windows"""
    cfg = open(NPP_CFG).read()
    enable = "yes" if mode == "dark" else "no"
    winmode = "yes" if mode == "follow-windows" else "no"
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode" enable=")\w+(")', r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % enable, cfg)
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*enableWindowsMode=")\w+(")',
                 r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % winmode, cfg)
    open(NPP_CFG, "w").write(cfg)
    m = re.search(r'<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*>', cfg)
    print("  config:", "enable=" + re.search(r'enable="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1),
          "enableWindowsMode=" + re.search(r'enableWindowsMode="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1))


def kill_npp(env):
    subprocess.run(["pkill", "-9", "-f", "notepad++.exe"], env=env)
    subprocess.run(["pkill", "-9", "-f", "winedevice"], env=env)
    time.sleep(2)


def run(wine, dllpath, tag, wait=14):
    env = dict(os.environ, DISPLAY=DISPLAY, WINEPREFIX=PREFIX, WINEDEBUG="-all")
    if dllpath:
        env["WINEDLLPATH"] = dllpath
    kill_npp(env)

    cmd = [wine, "C:\\NPP\\notepad++.exe"]
    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "npp_%s.log" % tag), "wb"),
                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    wid = ""
    for _ in range(wait * 2):
        out = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "search", "--name", "Notepad++"], env=env,
                             capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
        if out:
            wid = out[-1]
            break
        time.sleep(0.5)
    if not wid:
        print("  ERROR: no Notepad++ window appeared")
        return None
    time.sleep(4)
    geo = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "getwindowgeometry", wid], env=env,
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    m = re.search(r"Position: (\d+),(\d+).*?Geometry: (\d+)x(\d+)", geo, re.S)
    x, y, w, h = (int(g) for g in m.groups())
    shot = os.path.join(WD, "shot_%s.png" % tag)
    subprocess.run(["import", "-window", "root", shot], env=env)
    im = Image.open(shot).convert("RGB")

    def row(dy):
        yy = y + dy
        return [im.getpixel((x + int(w * f), yy)) for f in (0.05, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8)]

    res = {"geom": (x, y, w, h), "shot": shot,
           "menu": row(9), "toolbar": row(30), "editor": [im.getpixel((x + w // 2, y + 130))]}
    return res, env


def verdict(res):
    def is_light(px):
        return min(px) > LIGHTISH or sum(px) / 3 > LIGHTISH

    menu = res["menu"]
    chrome = res["toolbar"] + res["editor"]
    menu_light = sum(is_light(p) for p in menu) >= 3
    chrome_dark = sum(not is_light(p) for p in chrome) >= 3
    print("  menu bar  :", menu)
    print("  toolbar   :", res["toolbar"])
    print("  editor    :", res["editor"])
    if chrome_dark and menu_light:
        return "BUG (chrome dark, menu bar light)"
    if chrome_dark and not menu_light:
        return "OK (dark mode fully applied)"
    if not chrome_dark and menu_light:
        return "LIGHT MODE"
    return "UNEXPECTED"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--wine", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--dllpath", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--mode", default="dark", choices=["dark", "light", "follow-windows"])
    ap.add_argument("--tag", default="test")
    ap.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    start_xvfb()
    print("mode:", a.mode)
    set_config(a.mode)
    r = run(a.wine, a.dllpath, a.tag)
    if r:
        res, env = r
        print("verdict:", verdict(res))
        if not a.keep:
            kill_npp(env)

#!/bin/bash
# Regenerate the Wine patch series from patches-draft/orig vs wine-src.
set -e
WD="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
ORIG="$WD/patches-draft/orig"
SRC="$WD/wine-src"
OUT="$WD/patches"
mkdir -p "$OUT"

new_file_diff() {  # path
    local p="$1"
    diff -u --label "a/$p" --label "b/$p" /dev/null "$SRC/$p" || true
}
mod_file_diff() {  # path
    local p="$1"
    diff -u --label "a/$p" --label "b/$p" "$ORIG/$p" "$SRC/$p" || true
}

{
    echo "From: omp <omp@localhost>"
    echo "Subject: [PATCH 1/3] win32u: Add dark mode state for the undocumented Windows APIs"
    echo
    echo "Windows 10 1809+ exposes SetPreferredAppMode/AllowDarkModeForWindow through"
    echo "uxtheme; apps (e.g. Notepad++) use them to opt into dark mode."
    echo "---"
    for f in dlls/win32u/Makefile.in dlls/win32u/win32u.spec dlls/win32u/win32u_private.h \
             dlls/win32u/window.c include/ntuser.h dlls/win32u/darkmode.c; do
        if [ -f "$ORIG/$f" ]; then mod_file_diff "$f"; else new_file_diff "$f"; fi
    done
} > "$OUT/0001-win32u-Add-dark-mode-state.patch"

{
    echo "From: omp <omp@localhost>"
    echo "Subject: [PATCH 2/3] win32u: Send the UAH messages when drawing a dark menu bar"
    echo
    echo "Applications that opted into dark mode (WM_UAHDRAWMENU / WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM)"
    echo "draw the menu bar themselves, matching Windows 10 1809+ behaviour."
    echo "---"
    mod_file_diff dlls/win32u/menu.c
} > "$OUT/0002-win32u-Send-UAH-menu-bar-messages.patch"

{
    echo "From: omp <omp@localhost>"
    echo "Subject: [PATCH 3/3] uxtheme: Implement the undocumented dark mode entry points"
    echo
    echo "Forward the ordinal-only exports to win32u so that applications can actually"
    echo "enable dark mode and receive the UAH menu bar messages."
    echo "---"
    for f in dlls/uxtheme/Makefile.in dlls/uxtheme/system.c; do mod_file_diff "$f"; done
} > "$OUT/0003-uxtheme-Implement-dark-mode-entry-points.patch"

wc -l "$OUT"/*.patch

# STATE — Wine patches to make Notepad++ dark mode run like Windows

Last updated: 2026-10-04 (session 1)
Working dir: /home/asdf/projects/npp-darkmode-wine

## MISSION
Make Notepad++ dark mode (esp. menu bar) work under Wine exactly as on Windows,
by producing Wine patches (uxtheme + win32u). Verify against a Windows VM.
Do NOT submit upstream (LLM rule). Working dir must contain ALL patches used;
app-exclusive patches go in `patches/app-specific/npp/`.

## BUG
Wine bug 57555 ("Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark mode is not fully applied", UNCONFIRMED).
Wine 10.0-rc2 report. Repro: NPP > Settings > Preferences > Dark Mode > "Dark mode".
Menu bar stays light (pure #FFFFFF) while editor/toolbar go dark.

## REPRODUCED (session 1)
- NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64 (latest 2026-09-24) + Wine 11.18 Staging (/opt/wine-staging).
- Pixel proof: menu row (255,255,255) in BOTH light and dark; toolbar/editor (32,32,32)/(63,63,63).
- Artifacts: shot_final_dark.png, compare_light_vs_dark.png, shot_prefs_dark.png,
  probe.c/.exe, src/, menu.c (upstream 11.18 win32u/menu.c), bug-57555.xml.

## ROOT CAUSE (evidence-backed)
- NPP darkens the menu bar ONLY via the undocumented UAH protocol:
  wndproc subclass handles WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x0091) / WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x0092)
  (src/NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210, UAHMenuBar.h; structs UAHMENU/UAHDRAWMENUITEM/
   UAHMENUITEM/UAHMENUITEMMETRICS).
- NPP enables it via uxtheme ordinals: 133 AllowDarkModeForWindow,
  135 SetPreferredAppMode (>=18362), 136 FlushMenuThemes, 137 IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow,
  104 RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState, 49 OpenNcThemeData  (src/DarkMode.cpp:284-333).
  `AllowDarkModeForApp(allow)` -> SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark=2) (src/DarkMode.cpp:42-75).
  `SetDarkMode()` -> AllowDarkModeForApp(useDark) + FlushMenuThemes().
- Probe under Wine 11.18: all those ordinals resolve (so NPP g_darkModeSupported=TRUE),
  BUT: AllowDarkModeForWindow -> FALSE, IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow -> FALSE,
  SetPreferredAppMode -> 0, and **zero** UAH messages ever delivered.
- Wine 11.18 source: dlls/uxtheme/system.c -> those are `FIXME("stub")`.
  dlls/win32u/menu.c has NO dark/UAH handling; include/winuser.h lacks WM_UAH*.
- Wine reports 10.0 build 19045 (passes NPP's CheckBuildNumber; >=19041 so NPP's
  setDarkTitleBar takes the DwmSetWindowAttribute path, and dark forcing comes from
  SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark)).

## DESIGN (current)
1. win32u: new per-process dark-mode state + entry points:
   NtUserSetPreferredAppMode(int)->prev, NtUserAllowDarkModeForWindow(HWND,BOOL)->BOOL,
   NtUserIsDarkModeAllowedForWindow(HWND)->BOOL, NtUserFlushMenuThemes().
   Mode semantics: Default=0, AllowDark=1, ForceDark=2, ForceLight=3.
   Dark for window = (mode==ForceDark) || (mode==AllowDark && per-window flag).
2. uxtheme/system.c: ordinals 133/135/136/137/104 forward to the win32u functions
   (spec: wire via win32u.NtUser* forwarding).
3. win32u/menu.c NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp(): when dark allowed for hwnd ->
   send WM_UAHINITMENU (0x93); send WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x91) with UAHMENU{hmenu,hdc,flags};
   per item send WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x92) with UAHDRAWMENUITEM{dis,um,umi};
   skip default bar background + default item drawing when app handles it.
   Also WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM (0x94) in calc_menu_bar_size per bar item.
   Layer sizes: UAHMENUITEMMETRICS union rgsizeBar[2]{cx,cy}/rgsizePopup[4]{cx,cy}.
4. Popups (WM_UAHNCPAINTMENUPOPUP 0x95) — phase 2 if needed.

## PATHS / ASSETS
- wine-src/           pristine wine-11.18 (dl.winehq.org tarball), to be patched+built.
- patches/            output patch series (git format-patch style). [to create]
- patches/app-specific/npp/   app-exclusive patches. [to create]
- prefix/             NPP test WINEPREFIX (win64).
- npp/                NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64.
- probe.c/probe.exe   UAH/uxtheme probe harness.
- src/                NPP dark-mode sources (upstream master).
- Xvfb :99            used for NPP runs (started/stopped ad hoc).
- Windows VM: UNAVAILABLE — the win11 libvirt VM is in use by another agent (user
  clarification 2026-10-04). DO NOT touch it. Windows-side oracle = Notepad++ source
  (src/UAHMenuBar.h + NppDarkMode.cpp) which IS the win32 contract spec, plus
  reference UAH implementations. Verification oracle = the app itself under Wine.

## NEXT ACTIONS
1. Power on Windows VM; capture baseline (NPP dark mode on real Windows + API trace).
2. Configure+build wine-src (--enable-archs=x86_64), verify NPP bug reproduces on built wine.
3. Implement phases 1-3, rebuild, test on NPP, iterate vs Windows.
4. Package patches + docs; mark app-exclusive ones.

## RULES FROM USER
- Reward over cost; saturate CPU but never OOM (check mem/disk first).
- ~10 or fewer parallel subagents; store state for compaction.
- VNC display for autonomous GUI interaction.
- Use WineHQ wiki building instructions; Wine best practices; no upstream submission.
- If fix is config/fonts not patches -> document reproducible fix.

# STATE — Wine patches to make Notepad++ dark mode run like Windows

Last updated: 2026-10-04 (session 1)
Working dir: /home/asdf/projects/npp-darkmode-wine

## MISSION
Make Notepad++ dark mode (esp. menu bar) work under Wine exactly as on Windows,
by producing Wine patches (uxtheme + win32u). Verify against a Windows VM.
Do NOT submit upstream (LLM rule). Working dir must contain ALL patches used;
app-exclusive patches go in `patches/app-specific/npp/`.

## BUG
Wine bug 57555 ("Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark mode is not fully applied", UNCONFIRMED).
Wine 10.0-rc2 report. Repro: NPP > Settings > Preferences > Dark Mode > "Dark mode".
Menu bar stays light (pure #FFFFFF) while editor/toolbar go dark.

## REPRODUCED (session 1)
- NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64 (latest 2026-09-24) + Wine 11.18 Staging (/opt/wine-staging).
- Pixel proof: menu row (255,255,255) in BOTH light and dark; toolbar/editor (32,32,32)/(63,63,63).
- Artifacts: shot_final_dark.png, compare_light_vs_dark.png, shot_prefs_dark.png,
  probe.c/.exe, src/, menu.c (upstream 11.18 win32u/menu.c), bug-57555.xml.

## ROOT CAUSE (evidence-backed)
- NPP darkens the menu bar ONLY via the undocumented UAH protocol:
  wndproc subclass handles WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x0091) / WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x0092)
  (src/NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210, UAHMenuBar.h; structs UAHMENU/UAHDRAWMENUITEM/
   UAHMENUITEM/UAHMENUITEMMETRICS).
- NPP enables it via uxtheme ordinals: 133 AllowDarkModeForWindow,
  135 SetPreferredAppMode (>=18362), 136 FlushMenuThemes, 137 IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow,
  104 RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState, 49 OpenNcThemeData  (src/DarkMode.cpp:284-333).
  `AllowDarkModeForApp(allow)` -> SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark=2) (src/DarkMode.cpp:42-75).
  `SetDarkMode()` -> AllowDarkModeForApp(useDark) + FlushMenuThemes().
- Probe under Wine 11.18: all those ordinals resolve (so NPP g_darkModeSupported=TRUE),
  BUT: AllowDarkModeForWindow -> FALSE, IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow -> FALSE,
  SetPreferredAppMode -> 0, and **zero** UAH messages ever delivered.
- Wine 11.18 source: dlls/uxtheme/system.c -> those are `FIXME("stub")`.
  dlls/win32u/menu.c has NO dark/UAH handling; include/winuser.h lacks WM_UAH*.
- Wine reports 10.0 build 19045 (passes NPP's CheckBuildNumber; >=19041 so NPP's
  setDarkTitleBar takes the DwmSetWindowAttribute path, and dark forcing comes from
  SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark)).

## DESIGN (current)
1. win32u: new per-process dark-mode state + entry points:
   NtUserSetPreferredAppMode(int)->prev, NtUserAllowDarkModeForWindow(HWND,BOOL)->BOOL,
   NtUserIsDarkModeAllowedForWindow(HWND)->BOOL, NtUserFlushMenuThemes().
   Mode semantics: Default=0, AllowDark=1, ForceDark=2, ForceLight=3.
   Dark for window = (mode==ForceDark) || (mode==AllowDark && per-window flag).
2. uxtheme/system.c: ordinals 133/135/136/137/104 forward to the win32u functions
   (spec: wire via win32u.NtUser* forwarding).
3. win32u/menu.c NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp(): when dark allowed for hwnd ->
   send WM_UAHINITMENU (0x93); send WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x91) with UAHMENU{hmenu,hdc,flags};
   per item send WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x92) with UAHDRAWMENUITEM{dis,um,umi};
   skip default bar background + default item drawing when app handles it.
   Also WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM (0x94) in calc_menu_bar_size per bar item.
   Layer sizes: UAHMENUITEMMETRICS union rgsizeBar[2]{cx,cy}/rgsizePopup[4]{cx,cy}.

- wine-src/           pristine wine-11.18 (dl.winehq.org tarball), to be patched+built.
- patches/            output patch series (git format-patch style). [to create]
- patches/app-specific/npp/   app-exclusive patches. [to create]
- prefix/             NPP test WINEPREFIX (win64).
- npp/                NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64.
- probe.c/probe.exe   UAH/uxtheme probe harness.
- src/                NPP dark-mode sources (upstream master).
- Xvfb :99            used for NPP runs (started/stopped ad hoc).
- Windows VM: UNAVAILABLE — the win11 libvirt VM is in use by another agent (user
  clarification 2026-10-04). DO NOT touch it. Windows-side oracle = Notepad++ source
  (src/UAHMenuBar.h + NppDarkMode.cpp) which IS the win32 contract spec, plus
  reference UAH implementations. Verification oracle = the app itself under Wine.

## PROGRESS (session 1)
- Pristine wine-11.18 extracted to wine-src/, configured in wine-build/ (--enable-archs=x86_64).
- Patch implemented in wine-src (see patches/ once generated by tools/make_patches.sh):
  1. dlls/win32u/darkmode.c (new): per-process app mode + per-window overrides;
     NtUserSetPreferredAppMode / NtUserAllowDarkModeForWindow /
     NtUserIsDarkModeAllowedForWindow / NtUserFlushMenuThemes.
     Dark for window = ForceDark app mode, or per-window ALLOW; DISALLOW wins.
  2. dlls/win32u/win32u.spec: 4 new -syscall entries (appended at end of file).
  3. dlls/win32u/menu.c: UAH structs + draw_dark_menu_bar(); NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp()
     calls it and skips default drawing when true.
  4. dlls/uxtheme/system.c: ordinals 133/135/136/137 forward to win32u;
     ordinal 104 is a no-op.
  5. uxtheme/Makefile.in IMPORTS += win32u; window.c calls darkmode_remove_window();
     include/ntuser.h prototypes; win32u_private.h externs.

  work in wine 11.18 (probe2.exe), so theming is NOT the blocker.

  patch is currently expected: NPP uses the generic undocumented API set.

1. Power on Windows VM; capture baseline (NPP dark mode on real Windows + API trace).
2. Configure+build wine-src (--enable-archs=x86_64), verify NPP bug reproduces on built wine.
3. Implement phases 1-3, rebuild, test on NPP, iterate vs Windows.
4. Package patches + docs; mark app-exclusive ones.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run Notepad++ under Wine and report whether dark mode is actually applied.

Checks the menu bar (the bug), the toolbar and the editor background.
Menu bar light on white while the rest is dark == bug 57555 reproduced.
"""
import argparse
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from PIL import Image

WD = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
PREFIX = os.path.join(WD, "prefix")
NPP_CFG = os.path.join(PREFIX, "drive_c/NPP/config.xml")
DISPLAY = ":99"
LIGHTISH = 200  # channel value above which a pixel counts as "light"


def start_xvfb():
    if not os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
        subprocess.Popen(["Xvfb", DISPLAY, "-screen", "0", "1600x1000x24", "-nolisten", "tcp"],
                         stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "xvfb.log"), "wb"),
                         stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        for _ in range(100):
            if os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
                break
            time.sleep(0.1)
    return os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99")


def set_config(mode="dark"):
    """mode: dark | light | follow-windows"""
    cfg = open(NPP_CFG).read()
    enable = "yes" if mode == "dark" else "no"
    winmode = "yes" if mode == "follow-windows" else "no"
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode" enable=")\w+(")', r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % enable, cfg)
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*enableWindowsMode=")\w+(")',
                 r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % winmode, cfg)
    open(NPP_CFG, "w").write(cfg)
    m = re.search(r'<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*>', cfg)
    print("  config:", "enable=" + re.search(r'enable="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1),
          "enableWindowsMode=" + re.search(r'enableWindowsMode="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1))


def kill_npp(env):
    subprocess.run(["pkill", "-9", "-f", "notepad++.exe"], env=env)
    subprocess.run(["pkill", "-9", "-f", "winedevice"], env=env)
    time.sleep(2)


def run(wine, dllpath, tag, wait=14):
    env = dict(os.environ, DISPLAY=DISPLAY, WINEPREFIX=PREFIX, WINEDEBUG="-all")
    if dllpath:
        env["WINEDLLPATH"] = dllpath
    kill_npp(env)

    cmd = [wine, "C:\\NPP\\notepad++.exe"]
    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "npp_%s.log" % tag), "wb"),
                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    wid = ""
    for _ in range(wait * 2):
        out = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "search", "--name", "Notepad++"], env=env,
                             capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
        if out:
            wid = out[-1]
            break
        time.sleep(0.5)
    if not wid:
        print("  ERROR: no Notepad++ window appeared")
        return None
    time.sleep(4)
    geo = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "getwindowgeometry", wid], env=env,
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    m = re.search(r"Position: (\d+),(\d+).*?Geometry: (\d+)x(\d+)", geo, re.S)
    x, y, w, h = (int(g) for g in m.groups())
    shot = os.path.join(WD, "shot_%s.png" % tag)
    subprocess.run(["import", "-window", "root", shot], env=env)
    im = Image.open(shot).convert("RGB")

    def row(dy):
        yy = y + dy
        return [im.getpixel((x + int(w * f), yy)) for f in (0.05, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8)]

    res = {"geom": (x, y, w, h), "shot": shot,
           "menu": row(9), "toolbar": row(30), "editor": [im.getpixel((x + w // 2, y + 130))]}
    return res, env


def verdict(res):
    def is_light(px):
        return min(px) > LIGHTISH or sum(px) / 3 > LIGHTISH

    menu = res["menu"]
    chrome = res["toolbar"] + res["editor"]
    menu_light = sum(is_light(p) for p in menu) >= 3
    chrome_dark = sum(not is_light(p) for p in chrome) >= 3
    print("  menu bar  :", menu)
    print("  toolbar   :", res["toolbar"])
    print("  editor    :", res["editor"])
    if chrome_dark and menu_light:
        return "BUG (chrome dark, menu bar light)"
    if chrome_dark and not menu_light:
        return "OK (dark mode fully applied)"
    if not chrome_dark and menu_light:
        return "LIGHT MODE"
    return "UNEXPECTED"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--wine", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--dllpath", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--mode", default="dark", choices=["dark", "light", "follow-windows"])
    ap.add_argument("--tag", default="test")
    ap.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    start_xvfb()
    print("mode:", a.mode)
    set_config(a.mode)
    r = run(a.wine, a.dllpath, a.tag)
    if r:
        res, env = r
        print("verdict:", verdict(res))
        if not a.keep:
            kill_npp(env)

## BUILD ARCH NOTES (learned the hard way)
- win32u is a dual module: `MODULE = win32u.dll` + `UNIXLIB = win32u.so`.
  The *real* implementations (menu.c, window.c, defwnd.c, ...) are compiled into the
  **unix** library win32u.so; the PE win32u.dll only links main.c + generated syscall
  thunks. So new win32u source files MUST carry `#pragma makedep unix`, otherwise
  makedep builds them for the PE side and they fail on wine/gdi_driver.h
  ("can only be used on the Unix side").
- New win32u source: add to SOURCES in dlls/win32u/Makefile.in AND put
  `#pragma makedep unix` at the top of the file. Include order must start with
  ntgdi_private.h (which pulls win32u_private.h) before ntuser_private.h.
- After Makefile.in changes: run ./config.status then make (make caches Makefiles).
- dlls/win32u/x86_64-windows/win32u.dll links ONLY main.o -> implementations are unix-side.
- Test harness: tools/npp_dark_test.py samples median of blank menu-bar/toolbar bands
  (x 0.60-0.90) after parking the pointer at (1500,980); stock wine correctly => BUG.

# STATE — Wine patches to make Notepad++ dark mode run like Windows

Last updated: 2026-10-04 (session 1)
Working dir: /home/asdf/projects/npp-darkmode-wine

## MISSION
Make Notepad++ dark mode (esp. menu bar) work under Wine exactly as on Windows,
by producing Wine patches (uxtheme + win32u). Verify against a Windows VM.
Do NOT submit upstream (LLM rule). Working dir must contain ALL patches used;
app-exclusive patches go in `patches/app-specific/npp/`.

## BUG
Wine bug 57555 ("Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark mode is not fully applied", UNCONFIRMED).
Wine 10.0-rc2 report. Repro: NPP > Settings > Preferences > Dark Mode > "Dark mode".
Menu bar stays light (pure #FFFFFF) while editor/toolbar go dark.

## REPRODUCED (session 1)
- NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64 (latest 2026-09-24) + Wine 11.18 Staging (/opt/wine-staging).
- Pixel proof: menu row (255,255,255) in BOTH light and dark; toolbar/editor (32,32,32)/(63,63,63).
- Artifacts: shot_final_dark.png, compare_light_vs_dark.png, shot_prefs_dark.png,
  probe.c/.exe, src/, menu.c (upstream 11.18 win32u/menu.c), bug-57555.xml.

## ROOT CAUSE (evidence-backed)
- NPP darkens the menu bar ONLY via the undocumented UAH protocol:
  wndproc subclass handles WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x0091) / WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x0092)
  (src/NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210, UAHMenuBar.h; structs UAHMENU/UAHDRAWMENUITEM/
   UAHMENUITEM/UAHMENUITEMMETRICS).
- NPP enables it via uxtheme ordinals: 133 AllowDarkModeForWindow,
  135 SetPreferredAppMode (>=18362), 136 FlushMenuThemes, 137 IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow,
  104 RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState, 49 OpenNcThemeData  (src/DarkMode.cpp:284-333).
  `AllowDarkModeForApp(allow)` -> SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark=2) (src/DarkMode.cpp:42-75).
  `SetDarkMode()` -> AllowDarkModeForApp(useDark) + FlushMenuThemes().
- Probe under Wine 11.18: all those ordinals resolve (so NPP g_darkModeSupported=TRUE),
  BUT: AllowDarkModeForWindow -> FALSE, IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow -> FALSE,
  SetPreferredAppMode -> 0, and **zero** UAH messages ever delivered.
- Wine 11.18 source: dlls/uxtheme/system.c -> those are `FIXME("stub")`.
  dlls/win32u/menu.c has NO dark/UAH handling; include/winuser.h lacks WM_UAH*.
- Wine reports 10.0 build 19045 (passes NPP's CheckBuildNumber; >=19041 so NPP's
  setDarkTitleBar takes the DwmSetWindowAttribute path, and dark forcing comes from
  SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark)).

## DESIGN (current)
1. win32u: new per-process dark-mode state + entry points:
   NtUserSetPreferredAppMode(int)->prev, NtUserAllowDarkModeForWindow(HWND,BOOL)->BOOL,
   NtUserIsDarkModeAllowedForWindow(HWND)->BOOL, NtUserFlushMenuThemes().
   Mode semantics: Default=0, AllowDark=1, ForceDark=2, ForceLight=3.
   Dark for window = (mode==ForceDark) || (mode==AllowDark && per-window flag).
2. uxtheme/system.c: ordinals 133/135/136/137/104 forward to the win32u functions
   (spec: wire via win32u.NtUser* forwarding).
3. win32u/menu.c NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp(): when dark allowed for hwnd ->
   send WM_UAHINITMENU (0x93); send WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x91) with UAHMENU{hmenu,hdc,flags};
   per item send WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x92) with UAHDRAWMENUITEM{dis,um,umi};
   skip default bar background + default item drawing when app handles it.
   Also WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM (0x94) in calc_menu_bar_size per bar item.
   Layer sizes: UAHMENUITEMMETRICS union rgsizeBar[2]{cx,cy}/rgsizePopup[4]{cx,cy}.
4. Popups (WM_UAHNCPAINTMENUPOPUP 0x95) — phase 2 if needed.

## PATHS / ASSETS
- wine-src/           pristine wine-11.18 (dl.winehq.org tarball), to be patched+built.
- patches/            output patch series (git format-patch style). [to create]
- patches/app-specific/npp/   app-exclusive patches. [to create]
- prefix/             NPP test WINEPREFIX (win64).
- npp/                NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64.
- probe.c/probe.exe   UAH/uxtheme probe harness.
- src/                NPP dark-mode sources (upstream master).
- Xvfb :99            used for NPP runs (started/stopped ad hoc).
- Windows VM: UNAVAILABLE — the win11 libvirt VM is in use by another agent (user
  clarification 2026-10-04). DO NOT touch it. Windows-side oracle = Notepad++ source
  (src/UAHMenuBar.h + NppDarkMode.cpp) which IS the win32 contract spec, plus
  reference UAH implementations. Verification oracle = the app itself under Wine.

## PROGRESS (session 1)
- Pristine wine-11.18 extracted to wine-src/, configured in wine-build/ (--enable-archs=x86_64).
- Patch implemented in wine-src (see patches/ once generated by tools/make_patches.sh):
  1. dlls/win32u/darkmode.c (new): per-process app mode + per-window overrides;
     NtUserSetPreferredAppMode / NtUserAllowDarkModeForWindow /
     NtUserIsDarkModeAllowedForWindow / NtUserFlushMenuThemes.
     Dark for window = ForceDark app mode, or per-window ALLOW; DISALLOW wins.
  2. dlls/win32u/win32u.spec: 4 new -syscall entries (appended at end of file).
  3. dlls/win32u/menu.c: UAH structs + draw_dark_menu_bar(); NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp()
     calls it and skips default drawing when true.
  4. dlls/uxtheme/system.c: ordinals 133/135/136/137 forward to win32u;
     ordinal 104 is a no-op.
  5. uxtheme/Makefile.in IMPORTS += win32u; window.c calls darkmode_remove_window();
     include/ntuser.h prototypes; win32u_private.h externs.
- Pristine copies of every edited file: patches-draft/orig/.
- Verified beforehand: OpenThemeData("Menu") + DrawThemeTextEx(MENU_BARITEM) already
  work in wine 11.18 (probe2.exe), so theming is NOT the blocker.
- Windows VM: SKIPPED per user (in use by another agent; 52GB image vs 18GB free).
  Oracle = Notepad++ source (src/UAHMenuBar.h, src/NppDarkMode.cpp). No app-exclusive
  patch is currently expected: NPP uses the generic undocumented API set.

## NEXT ACTIONS
1. Finish the wine build (wine-build, `make -j20`), fix any compile errors in the patch.
2. Run tools/npp_dark_test.py against the built wine: expect "OK (dark mode fully applied)".
3. Compare with /opt/wine-staging (stock 11.18) which must still show the bug.
4. Regenerate patches/ via tools/make_patches.sh; verify `patch -p1` applies to pristine.
5. If the bar stays light: debug with WINEDEBUG=+darkmode,+message, check that
   SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark) arrives and that UAH messages reach NPP's subclass.

## RULES FROM USER
- Reward over cost; saturate CPU but never OOM (check mem/disk first).
- ~10 or fewer parallel subagents; store state for compaction.
- VNC display for autonomous GUI interaction.
- Use WineHQ wiki building instructions; Wine best practices; no upstream submission.
- If fix is config/fonts not patches -> document reproducible fix.
- If app can't run / can't be licensed due to missing kernel APIs -> document and stop.

#!/bin/bash
# Regenerate the Wine patch series: patches-draft/orig (pristine) vs wine-src (patched).
set -e
WD="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
ORIG="$WD/patches-draft/orig"
SRC="$WD/wine-src"
OUT="$WD/patches"
mkdir -p "$OUT"

diff_one() {  # path
    local p="$1"
    if [ -f "$ORIG/$p" ]; then
        diff -u --label "a/$p" --label "b/$p" "$ORIG/$p" "$SRC/$p" || true
    else
        diff -u --label "a/$p" --label "b/$p" /dev/null "$SRC/$p" || true
    fi
}

{
    echo "From: omp <omp@localhost>"
    echo "Subject: [PATCH 1/3] win32u: Let the application draw a dark menu bar"
    echo
    echo "Windows 10 1809+ sends the undocumented UAH messages (WM_UAHDRAWMENU /"
    echo "WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM) to windows that use dark mode, letting the application"
    echo "paint the menu bar itself. Notepad++ 8.x relies on this to theme its menu bar."
    echo
    echo "A window is considered dark when the __wine_dark_mode property is set, which"
    echo "is done by uxtheme's AllowDarkModeForWindow and by dwmapi's"
    echo "DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE attribute."
    echo "---"
    diff_one dlls/win32u/menu.c
} > "$OUT/0001-win32u-Send-UAH-menu-bar-messages.patch"

{
    echo "From: omp <omp@localhost>"
    echo "Subject: [PATCH 2/3] uxtheme: Implement the undocumented dark mode entry points"
    echo
    echo "AllowDarkModeForWindow/IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow now track a per-window flag,"
    echo "and SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark) marks the existing windows of the process,"
    echo "instead of being no-op stubs that report failure."
    echo "---"
    diff_one dlls/uxtheme/system.c
} > "$OUT/0002-uxtheme-Implement-dark-mode-entry-points.patch"

{
    echo "From: omp <omp@localhost>"
    echo "Subject: [PATCH 3/3] dwmapi: Implement the DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE attribute"
    echo
    echo "Store the immersive dark mode state per window instead of ignoring it, so that"
    echo "applications using the documented DWM attribute (Notepad++ on Windows 10 2004+)"
    echo "get dark decorations and a dark menu bar."
    echo "---"
    diff_one dlls/dwmapi/dwmapi_main.c
} > "$OUT/0003-dwmapi-Implement-immersive-dark-mode.patch"

wc -l "$OUT"/*.patch

## DESIGN v2 (current, after v1 was abandoned)
v1 added 4 new win32u syscalls (darkmode.c). ABANDONED: adding win32u syscalls also
requires updating the checked-in generated table dlls/win32u/win32syscalls.h
("Automatically generated by tools/make_specfiles", 3080 SYSCALL_ENTRY lines); the PE
win32u.dll link then fails with undefined references to the new exports. All v1 changes
were reverted (files restored from patches-draft/orig; darkmode.c deleted).

v2 uses existing, documented mechanisms and needs no new syscalls:
- Per-window state in a window property `__wine_dark_mode` (1 = dark, 2 = explicitly
  light, absent = unset). Written via SetPropW (user32), read in win32u via NtUserGetProp.
- dlls/dwmapi/dwmapi_main.c: DwmSetWindowAttribute/DwmGetWindowAttribute implement
  DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE (=20) by setting/reading that property. Notepad++ 8.9.8.1
  uses exactly this on build >= 19041 (NppDarkMode.cpp:4236, Windows reports 19045).
- dlls/uxtheme/system.c: AllowDarkModeForWindow/IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow use the
  property; SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark) marks existing windows of the process via
  EnumWindows; FlushMenuThemes/RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState are no-ops.
- dlls/win32u/menu.c: is_dark_mode_allowed_for_window() = property == 1; when true,
  NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp() sends WM_UAHINITMENU + WM_UAHDRAWMENU + per-item
  WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM and skips the default drawing.
Patch set: 3 patches (menu.c, system.c, dwmapi_main.c). No app-exclusive patches.

# STATE — Wine patches to make Notepad++ dark mode run like Windows

Last updated: 2026-10-04 (session 1)
Working dir: /home/asdf/projects/npp-darkmode-wine

## MISSION
Make Notepad++ dark mode (esp. menu bar) work under Wine exactly as on Windows,
by producing Wine patches (uxtheme + win32u). Verify against a Windows VM.
Do NOT submit upstream (LLM rule). Working dir must contain ALL patches used;
app-exclusive patches go in `patches/app-specific/npp/`.

## BUG
Wine bug 57555 ("Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark mode is not fully applied", UNCONFIRMED).
Wine 10.0-rc2 report. Repro: NPP > Settings > Preferences > Dark Mode > "Dark mode".
Menu bar stays light (pure #FFFFFF) while editor/toolbar go dark.

## REPRODUCED (session 1)
- NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64 (latest 2026-09-24) + Wine 11.18 Staging (/opt/wine-staging).
- Pixel proof: menu row (255,255,255) in BOTH light and dark; toolbar/editor (32,32,32)/(63,63,63).
- Artifacts: shot_final_dark.png, compare_light_vs_dark.png, shot_prefs_dark.png,
  probe.c/.exe, src/, menu.c (upstream 11.18 win32u/menu.c), bug-57555.xml.

## ROOT CAUSE (evidence-backed)
- NPP darkens the menu bar ONLY via the undocumented UAH protocol:
  wndproc subclass handles WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x0091) / WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x0092)
  (src/NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210, UAHMenuBar.h; structs UAHMENU/UAHDRAWMENUITEM/
   UAHMENUITEM/UAHMENUITEMMETRICS).
- NPP enables it via uxtheme ordinals: 133 AllowDarkModeForWindow,
  135 SetPreferredAppMode (>=18362), 136 FlushMenuThemes, 137 IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow,
  104 RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState, 49 OpenNcThemeData  (src/DarkMode.cpp:284-333).
  `AllowDarkModeForApp(allow)` -> SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark=2) (src/DarkMode.cpp:42-75).
  `SetDarkMode()` -> AllowDarkModeForApp(useDark) + FlushMenuThemes().
- Probe under Wine 11.18: all those ordinals resolve (so NPP g_darkModeSupported=TRUE),
  BUT: AllowDarkModeForWindow -> FALSE, IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow -> FALSE,
  SetPreferredAppMode -> 0, and **zero** UAH messages ever delivered.
- Wine 11.18 source: dlls/uxtheme/system.c -> those are `FIXME("stub")`.
  dlls/win32u/menu.c has NO dark/UAH handling; include/winuser.h lacks WM_UAH*.
- Wine reports 10.0 build 19045 (passes NPP's CheckBuildNumber; >=19041 so NPP's
  setDarkTitleBar takes the DwmSetWindowAttribute path, and dark forcing comes from
  SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark)).

## DESIGN (current)
1. win32u: new per-process dark-mode state + entry points:
   NtUserSetPreferredAppMode(int)->prev, NtUserAllowDarkModeForWindow(HWND,BOOL)->BOOL,
   NtUserIsDarkModeAllowedForWindow(HWND)->BOOL, NtUserFlushMenuThemes().
   Mode semantics: Default=0, AllowDark=1, ForceDark=2, ForceLight=3.
   Dark for window = (mode==ForceDark) || (mode==AllowDark && per-window flag).
2. uxtheme/system.c: ordinals 133/135/136/137/104 forward to the win32u functions
   (spec: wire via win32u.NtUser* forwarding).
3. win32u/menu.c NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp(): when dark allowed for hwnd ->
   send WM_UAHINITMENU (0x93); send WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x91) with UAHMENU{hmenu,hdc,flags};
   per item send WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x92) with UAHDRAWMENUITEM{dis,um,umi};
   skip default bar background + default item drawing when app handles it.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run Notepad++ under Wine and report whether dark mode is actually applied.

Checks the menu bar (the bug), the toolbar and the editor background.
Menu bar light on white while the rest is dark == bug 57555 reproduced.
"""
import argparse
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from PIL import Image

WD = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
PREFIX = os.path.join(WD, "prefix")
NPP_CFG = os.path.join(PREFIX, "drive_c/NPP/config.xml")
DISPLAY = ":99"
LIGHTISH = 200  # channel value above which a pixel counts as "light"


def start_xvfb():
    if not os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
        subprocess.Popen(["Xvfb", DISPLAY, "-screen", "0", "1600x1000x24", "-nolisten", "tcp"],
                         stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "xvfb.log"), "wb"),
                         stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        for _ in range(100):
            if os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
                break
            time.sleep(0.1)
    return os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99")


def set_config(mode="dark"):
    """mode: dark | light | follow-windows"""
    cfg = open(NPP_CFG).read()
    enable = "yes" if mode == "dark" else "no"
    winmode = "yes" if mode == "follow-windows" else "no"
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode" enable=")\w+(")', r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % enable, cfg)
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*enableWindowsMode=")\w+(")',
                 r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % winmode, cfg)
    open(NPP_CFG, "w").write(cfg)
    m = re.search(r'<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*>', cfg)
    print("  config:", "enable=" + re.search(r'enable="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1),
          "enableWindowsMode=" + re.search(r'enableWindowsMode="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1))


def kill_npp(env):
    subprocess.run(["pkill", "-9", "-f", "notepad++.exe"], env=env)
    subprocess.run(["pkill", "-9", "-f", "winedevice"], env=env)
    time.sleep(2)


def run(wine, dllpath, tag, wait=14):
    env = dict(os.environ, DISPLAY=DISPLAY, WINEPREFIX=PREFIX, WINEDEBUG="-all")
    if dllpath:
        env["WINEDLLPATH"] = dllpath
    kill_npp(env)

    cmd = [wine, "C:\\NPP\\notepad++.exe"]
    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "npp_%s.log" % tag), "wb"),
                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    wid = ""
    for _ in range(wait * 2):
        out = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "search", "--name", "Notepad++"], env=env,
                             capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
        if out:
            wid = out[-1]
            break
        time.sleep(0.5)
    if not wid:
        print("  ERROR: no Notepad++ window appeared")
        return None
    time.sleep(4)
    # park the pointer so hovering does not highlight menu items
    subprocess.run(["xdotool", "mousemove", "1500", "980"], env=env)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    geo = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "getwindowgeometry", wid], env=env,
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    m = re.search(r"Position: (\d+),(\d+).*?Geometry: (\d+)x(\d+)", geo, re.S)
    x, y, w, h = (int(g) for g in m.groups())
    shot = os.path.join(WD, "shot_%s.png" % tag)
    subprocess.run(["import", "-window", "root", shot], env=env)
    im = Image.open(shot).convert("RGB")

    def band(dy0, dy1, fx):
        """median colour over a band, sampling blank areas only"""
        px = [im.getpixel((x + int(w * f), y + dy))
              for dy in range(dy0, dy1 + 1) for f in fx]
        px.sort(key=lambda p: sum(p))
        return px[len(px) // 2]

    blank = (0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90)
    res = {"geom": (x, y, w, h), "shot": shot,
           "menu": band(6, 20, blank), "toolbar": band(30, 42, blank),
           "editor": im.getpixel((x + w // 2, y + 130))}
    return res, env


def verdict(res):
    def dark(px):
        return max(px) < 130

    print("  menu bar (median):", res["menu"])
    print("  toolbar  (median):", res["toolbar"])
    print("  editor            :", res["editor"])
    menu_dark, bar_dark = dark(res["menu"]), dark(res["toolbar"])
    if bar_dark and not menu_dark:
        return "BUG (chrome dark, menu bar light)"
    if bar_dark and menu_dark:
        return "OK (dark mode fully applied)"
    if not bar_dark and not menu_dark:
        return "LIGHT MODE"
    return "UNEXPECTED"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--wine", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--dllpath", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--mode", default="dark", choices=["dark", "light", "follow-windows"])
    ap.add_argument("--tag", default="test")
    ap.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    start_xvfb()
    print("mode:", a.mode)
    set_config(a.mode)
    r = run(a.wine, a.dllpath, a.tag)
    if r:
        res, env = r
        print("verdict:", verdict(res))
        if not a.keep:
            kill_npp(env)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run Notepad++ under Wine and report whether dark mode is actually applied.

Checks the menu bar (the bug), the toolbar and the editor background.
Menu bar light on white while the rest is dark == bug 57555 reproduced.
"""
import argparse
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from PIL import Image

WD = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
PREFIX = os.path.join(WD, "prefix")
NPP_CFG = os.path.join(PREFIX, "drive_c/NPP/config.xml")
DISPLAY = ":99"
LIGHTISH = 200  # channel value above which a pixel counts as "light"


def start_xvfb():
    if not os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
        subprocess.Popen(["Xvfb", DISPLAY, "-screen", "0", "1600x1000x24", "-nolisten", "tcp"],
                         stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "xvfb.log"), "wb"),
                         stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        for _ in range(100):
            if os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
                break
            time.sleep(0.1)
    return os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99")


def set_config(mode="dark"):
    """mode: dark | light | follow-windows"""
    cfg = open(NPP_CFG).read()
    enable = "yes" if mode == "dark" else "no"
    winmode = "yes" if mode == "follow-windows" else "no"
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode" enable=")\w+(")', r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % enable, cfg)
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*enableWindowsMode=")\w+(")',
                 r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % winmode, cfg)
    open(NPP_CFG, "w").write(cfg)
    m = re.search(r'<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*>', cfg)
    print("  config:", "enable=" + re.search(r'enable="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1),
          "enableWindowsMode=" + re.search(r'enableWindowsMode="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1))


def kill_prefix_wineserver():
    """kill every process (incl. the wineserver) using our WINEPREFIX"""
    import glob
    target = PREFIX.encode()
    for proc in glob.glob("/proc/[0-9]*"):
        try:
            data = open(proc + "/environ", "rb").read()
        except OSError:
            continue
        if any(e.startswith(b"WINEPREFIX=") and target in e for e in data.split(b"\0")):
            try:
                os.kill(int(proc.rsplit("/", 1)[1]), 9)
            except OSError:
                pass
    time.sleep(2)


def kill_npp(env):
    subprocess.run(["pkill", "-9", "-f", "notepad++.exe"], env=env)
    kill_prefix_wineserver()
    time.sleep(1)


def run(wine, dllpath, tag, wait=14):
    env = dict(os.environ, DISPLAY=DISPLAY, WINEPREFIX=PREFIX, WINEDEBUG="-all")
    if dllpath:
        env["WINEDLLPATH"] = dllpath
    kill_npp(env)

    cmd = [wine, "C:\\NPP\\notepad++.exe"]
    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "npp_%s.log" % tag), "wb"),
                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    wid = ""
    for _ in range(wait * 2):
        out = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "search", "--name", "Notepad++"], env=env,
                             capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
        if out:
            wid = out[-1]
            break
        time.sleep(0.5)
    if not wid:
        print("  ERROR: no Notepad++ window appeared")
        return None
    time.sleep(4)
    # park the pointer so hovering does not highlight menu items
    subprocess.run(["xdotool", "mousemove", "1500", "980"], env=env)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    geo = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "getwindowgeometry", wid], env=env,
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    m = re.search(r"Position: (\d+),(\d+).*?Geometry: (\d+)x(\d+)", geo, re.S)
    x, y, w, h = (int(g) for g in m.groups())
    shot = os.path.join(WD, "shot_%s.png" % tag)
    subprocess.run(["import", "-window", "root", shot], env=env)
    im = Image.open(shot).convert("RGB")

    def band(dy0, dy1, fx):
        """median colour over a band, sampling blank areas only"""
        px = [im.getpixel((x + int(w * f), y + dy))
              for dy in range(dy0, dy1 + 1) for f in fx]
        px.sort(key=lambda p: sum(p))
        return px[len(px) // 2]

    blank = (0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90)
    res = {"geom": (x, y, w, h), "shot": shot,
           "menu": band(6, 20, blank), "toolbar": band(30, 42, blank),
           "editor": im.getpixel((x + w // 2, y + 130))}
    return res, env


def verdict(res):
    def dark(px):
        return max(px) < 130

    print("  menu bar (median):", res["menu"])
    print("  toolbar  (median):", res["toolbar"])
    print("  editor            :", res["editor"])
    menu_dark, bar_dark = dark(res["menu"]), dark(res["toolbar"])
    if bar_dark and not menu_dark:
        return "BUG (chrome dark, menu bar light)"
    if bar_dark and menu_dark:
        return "OK (dark mode fully applied)"
    if not bar_dark and not menu_dark:
        return "LIGHT MODE"
    return "UNEXPECTED"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--wine", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--dllpath", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--mode", default="dark", choices=["dark", "light", "follow-windows"])
    ap.add_argument("--tag", default="test")
    ap.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    start_xvfb()
    print("mode:", a.mode)
    set_config(a.mode)
    r = run(a.wine, a.dllpath, a.tag)
    if r:
        res, env = r
        print("verdict:", verdict(res))
        if not a.keep:
            kill_npp(env)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run Notepad++ under Wine and report whether dark mode is actually applied.

Checks the menu bar (the bug), the toolbar and the editor background.
Menu bar light on white while the rest is dark == bug 57555 reproduced.
"""
import argparse
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from PIL import Image

WD = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
PREFIX = os.path.join(WD, "prefix")
NPP_CFG = os.path.join(PREFIX, "drive_c/NPP/config.xml")
DISPLAY = ":99"
LIGHTISH = 200  # channel value above which a pixel counts as "light"


def start_xvfb():
    if not os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
        subprocess.Popen(["Xvfb", DISPLAY, "-screen", "0", "1600x1000x24", "-nolisten", "tcp"],
                         stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "xvfb.log"), "wb"),
                         stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        for _ in range(100):
            if os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99"):
                break
            time.sleep(0.1)
    return os.path.exists("/tmp/.X11-unix/X99")


def set_config(mode="dark"):
    """mode: dark | light | follow-windows"""
    cfg = open(NPP_CFG).read()
    enable = "yes" if mode == "dark" else "no"
    winmode = "yes" if mode == "follow-windows" else "no"
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode" enable=")\w+(")', r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % enable, cfg)
    cfg = re.sub(r'(<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*enableWindowsMode=")\w+(")',
                 r"\g<1>%s\g<2>" % winmode, cfg)
    open(NPP_CFG, "w").write(cfg)
    m = re.search(r'<GUIConfig name="DarkMode"[^>]*>', cfg)
    print("  config:", "enable=" + re.search(r'enable="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1),
          "enableWindowsMode=" + re.search(r'enableWindowsMode="(\w+)"', m.group(0)).group(1))


def kill_prefix_wineserver():
    """kill every process (incl. the wineserver) using our WINEPREFIX"""
    import glob
    target = PREFIX.encode()
    for proc in glob.glob("/proc/[0-9]*"):
        try:
            data = open(proc + "/environ", "rb").read()
        except OSError:
            continue
        if any(e.startswith(b"WINEPREFIX=") and target in e for e in data.split(b"\0")):
            try:
                os.kill(int(proc.rsplit("/", 1)[1]), 9)
            except OSError:
                pass
    time.sleep(2)


def kill_npp(env):
    subprocess.run(["pkill", "-9", "-f", "notepad++.exe"], env=env)
    kill_prefix_wineserver()
    time.sleep(1)


def run(wine, dllpath, tag, wait=14):
    env = dict(os.environ, DISPLAY=DISPLAY, WINEPREFIX=PREFIX, WINEDEBUG="-all")
    if dllpath:
        env["WINEDLLPATH"] = dllpath
    kill_npp(env)

    cmd = [wine, "C:\\NPP\\notepad++.exe"]
    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=open(os.path.join(WD, "npp_%s.log" % tag), "wb"),
                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    wid = ""
    for _ in range(wait * 2):
        out = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "search", "--name", "Notepad++"], env=env,
                             capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
        if out:
            wid = out[-1]
            break
        time.sleep(0.5)
    if not wid:
        print("  ERROR: no Notepad++ window appeared")
        return None
    time.sleep(4)
    # park the pointer so hovering does not highlight menu items
    subprocess.run(["xdotool", "mousemove", "1500", "980"], env=env)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    geo = subprocess.run(["xdotool", "getwindowgeometry", wid], env=env,
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    m = re.search(r"Position: (\d+),(\d+).*?Geometry: (\d+)x(\d+)", geo, re.S)
    x, y, w, h = (int(g) for g in m.groups())
    shot = os.path.join(WD, "shot_%s.png" % tag)
    subprocess.run(["import", "-window", "root", shot], env=env)
    im = Image.open(shot).convert("RGB")

    def band(dy0, dy1, fx):
        """median colour over a band, sampling blank areas only"""
        px = [im.getpixel((x + int(w * f), y + dy))
              for dy in range(dy0, dy1 + 1) for f in fx]
        px.sort(key=lambda p: sum(p))
        return px[len(px) // 2]

    blank = (0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90)
    res = {"geom": (x, y, w, h), "shot": shot,
           "menu": band(6, 20, blank), "toolbar": band(30, 42, blank),
           "editor": im.getpixel((x + w // 2, y + 130))}
    return res, env


def verdict(res):
    def dark(px):
        return max(px) < 130

    print("  menu bar (median):", res["menu"])
    print("  toolbar  (median):", res["toolbar"])
    print("  editor            :", res["editor"])
    menu_dark, bar_dark = dark(res["menu"]), dark(res["toolbar"])
    if bar_dark and not menu_dark:
        return "BUG (chrome dark, menu bar light)"
    if bar_dark and menu_dark:
        return "OK (dark mode fully applied)"
    if not bar_dark and not menu_dark:
        return "LIGHT MODE"
    return "UNEXPECTED"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--wine", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--dllpath", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--mode", default="dark", choices=["dark", "light", "follow-windows"])
    ap.add_argument("--tag", default="test")
    ap.add_argument("--prefix", default=PREFIX)
    ap.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    PREFIX = a.prefix

    start_xvfb()
    print("mode:", a.mode)
    set_config(a.mode)
    r = run(a.wine, a.dllpath, a.tag)
    if r:
        res, env = r
        print("verdict:", verdict(res))
        if not a.keep:
            kill_npp(env)

# Notepad++ dark mode on Wine (Wine bug 57555)

Goal: make Notepad++ dark mode work under Wine the way it does on Windows, by
patching Wine. Notepad++ is a pure Win32 application (no frameworks/SDKs/browsers),
so the fix is a generic set of win32u/uxtheme/dwmapi patches — **not** an app hack,
and it does not depend on any patches from other projects. It is built on a pristine
`wine-11.18` tarball from dl.winehq.org.

## The bug
[Wine bug 57555](https://bugs.winehq.org/show_bug.cgi?id=57555): "Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark
mode is not fully applied, because the menu bar remains in light mode".
Reproduced here on Wine 11.18 with the latest Notepad++ 8.9.8.1:

| element | light mode | dark mode (stock wine) | dark mode (patched) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **menu bar** | `#FFFFFF` | **`#FFFFFF`** (bug) | **`#202020`** |
| toolbar | `#FFFFFF` | `#202020` | `#202020` |
| editor | `#FFFFFF` | `#3F3F3F` | `#3F3F3F` |

## Root cause
Notepad++ paints its menu bar itself, using the undocumented **UAH protocol** that
Windows 10 1809+ uses for dark-mode apps: it subclasses the frame window
(`NppBigSwitch.cpp:228`) and draws only in response to `WM_UAHDRAWMENU` (0x0091) /
`WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM` (0x0092) / `WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM` (0x0094)
(`NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210`, `src/full/PowerEditor/src/DarkMode/UAHMenuBar.h`).

Wine 11.18 never sends those messages, and the way the app signals dark mode is lost:
* `uxtheme`'s ordinal-only exports `AllowDarkModeForWindow` (133), `SetPreferredAppMode`
  (135), `FlushMenuThemes` (136), `IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow` (137) are `FIXME("stub")`
  that return `FALSE`/`0` (`dlls/uxtheme/system.c`).
* `dwmapi`'s `DwmSetWindowAttribute` ignores `DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE` (=20),
  which is what Notepad++ actually uses on Windows 10 2004+ (`NppDarkMode.cpp:4236`;
  Wine reports build 19045).
* `dlls/win32u/menu.c` has no dark-mode handling at all.

## The patches
Applied to `wine-src/` (see `patches/`, regenerate with `tools/make_patches.sh`):

1. `0001-win32u-Send-UAH-menu-bar-messages.patch`
   `NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp()` now checks whether the window uses dark mode and, if so,
   sends `WM_UAHINITMENU` + `WM_UAHDRAWMENU` + one `WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM` per item and
   skips the default drawing, letting the application paint its own dark menu bar.
   Dark mode is read from the `__wine_dark_mode` window property (1 = dark, 2 = light).
2. `0002-uxtheme-Implement-dark-mode-entry-points.patch`
   `AllowDarkModeForWindow` / `IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow` set/read that property instead
   of returning failure; `SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark)` marks the existing windows of
   the process; `FlushMenuThemes` / `RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState` are no-ops.
3. `0003-dwmapi-Implement-immersive-dark-mode.patch`
   `DwmSetWindowAttribute` / `DwmGetWindowAttribute` implement
   `DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE` by storing/reading the same property, so the
   documented API Notepad++ uses on modern Windows works.

All three are generic Win32 behaviour fixes (any dark-mode app benefits); **none are
Notepad++-specific**, so `patches/app-specific/npp/` is empty on purpose.

## Building
```sh
cd wine-src && ../wine-build/configure  # already done
cd wine-build && ./config.status && make -j$(nproc)
```
Build notes (see STATE.md -> "BUILD ARCH NOTES"): win32u is a dual module; its real
implementation lives in the unix library `win32u.so`, and unix-side wide string literals
must be `WCHAR` char arrays, not `L"..."`.

## Verifying
```sh
# 64-bit prefix for the patched build (the build is x86_64-only)
DISPLAY=:99 WINEPREFIX=$PWD/prefix-build $PWD/wine-build/wine wineboot -i
python3 tools/npp_dark_test.py --wine $PWD/wine-build/wine \
        --prefix $PWD/prefix-build --mode dark
```
Result on the patched build: `OK (dark mode fully applied)` — menu bar `(32,32,32)`.
On the stock Wine 11.18 (`/opt/wine-staging`): `BUG (chrome dark, menu bar light)`.
Light mode is unaffected (`LIGHT MODE`). Screenshots: `shot_patched_v5.png` (patched),
`shot_baseline_stock2.png` (stock), `shot_patched_light.png`.

## Known remaining differences vs Windows
* **Popup menus (File/Edit/... dropdowns) are still light** — on Windows they are drawn
  dark by the OS. This is the next item; see STATE.md.
* Scrollbars, status bar, dialogs already follow Notepad++'s own dark theme.

## Notes on method
* No Windows VM was used for this work (the available VM is owned by another agent and
  cannot be duplicated: 52 GB image, 18 GB free disk). The contract was taken from
  Notepad++'s own source, which is the authoritative description of what the app expects
  from the Win32 API.
* Patches must not be submitted upstream through this process (per instruction).

details.newText:
# Notepad++ dark mode on Wine (Wine bug 57555)

Goal: make Notepad++ dark mode work under Wine the way it does on Windows, by
patching Wine. Notepad++ is a pure Win32 application (no frameworks/SDKs/browsers),
so the fix is a generic set of win32u/uxtheme/dwmapi patches — **not** an app hack,
and it does not depend on any patches from other projects. It is built on a pristine
`wine-11.18` tarball from dl.winehq.org.

## The bug
[Wine bug 57555](https://bugs.winehq.org/show_bug.cgi?id=57555): "Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark
mode is not fully applied, because the menu bar remains in light mode".
Reproduced here on Wine 11.18 with the latest Notepad++ 8.9.8.1:

| element | light mode | dark mode (stock wine) | dark mode (patched) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **menu bar** | `#FFFFFF` | **`#FFFFFF`** (bug) | **`#202020`** |
| toolbar | `#FFFFFF` | `#202020` | `#202020` |
| editor | `#FFFFFF` | `#3F3F3F` | `#3F3F3F` |

## Root cause
Notepad++ paints its menu bar itself, using the undocumented **UAH protocol** that
Windows 10 1809+ uses for dark-mode apps: it subclasses the frame window
(`NppBigSwitch.cpp:228`) and draws only in response to `WM_UAHDRAWMENU` (0x0091) /
`WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM` (0x0092) / `WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM` (0x0094)
(`NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210`, `src/full/PowerEditor/src/DarkMode/UAHMenuBar.h`).

Wine 11.18 never sends those messages, and the way the app signals dark mode is lost:
* `uxtheme`'s ordinal-only exports `AllowDarkModeForWindow` (133), `SetPreferredAppMode`
  (135), `FlushMenuThemes` (136), `IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow` (137) are `FIXME("stub")`
  that return `FALSE`/`0` (`dlls/uxtheme/system.c`).
* `dwmapi`'s `DwmSetWindowAttribute` ignores `DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE` (=20),
  which is what Notepad++ actually uses on Windows 10 2004+ (`NppDarkMode.cpp:4236`;
  Wine reports build 19045).
* `dlls/win32u/menu.c` has no dark-mode handling at all.

## The patches
Applied to `wine-src/` (see `patches/`, regenerate with `tools/make_patches.sh`):

1. `0001-win32u-Send-UAH-menu-bar-messages.patch`
   `NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp()` now checks whether the window uses dark mode and, if so,
   sends `WM_UAHINITMENU` + `WM_UAHDRAWMENU` + one `WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM` per item and
   skips the default drawing, letting the application paint its own dark menu bar.
   Dark mode is read from the `__wine_dark_mode` window property (1 = dark, 2 = light).
2. `0002-uxtheme-Implement-dark-mode-entry-points.patch`
   `AllowDarkModeForWindow` / `IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow` set/read that property instead
   of returning failure; `SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark)` marks the existing windows of
   the process; `FlushMenuThemes` / `RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState` are no-ops.
3. `0003-dwmapi-Implement-immersive-dark-mode.patch`
   `DwmSetWindowAttribute` / `DwmGetWindowAttribute` implement
   `DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE` by storing/reading the same property, so the
   documented API Notepad++ uses on modern Windows works.

All three are generic Win32 behaviour fixes (any dark-mode app benefits); **none are
Notepad++-specific**, so `patches/app-specific/npp/` is empty on purpose.

## Building
```sh
cd wine-build && ../wine-src/configure --enable-archs=x86_64   # already done
cd wine-build && ./config.status && make -j$(nproc)
```
Build notes (see STATE.md -> "BUILD ARCH NOTES"): win32u is a dual module; its real
implementation lives in the unix library `win32u.so`, and unix-side wide string literals
must be `WCHAR` char arrays, not `L"..."`.

## Verifying
```sh
# 64-bit prefix for the patched build (the build is x86_64-only)
DISPLAY=:99 WINEPREFIX=$PWD/prefix-build $PWD/wine-build/wine wineboot -i
python3 tools/npp_dark_test.py --wine $PWD/wine-build/wine \
        --prefix $PWD/prefix-build --mode dark
```
Result on the patched build: `OK (dark mode fully applied)` — menu bar `(32,32,32)`.
On the stock Wine 11.18 (`/opt/wine-staging`): `BUG (chrome dark, menu bar light)`.
Light mode is unaffected (`LIGHT MODE`). Screenshots: `shot_patched_v5.png` (patched),
`shot_baseline_stock2.png` (stock), `shot_patched_light.png`.

## Known remaining differences vs Windows
* **Popup menus (File/Edit/... dropdowns) are still light** — on Windows they are drawn
  dark by the OS. This is the next item; see STATE.md.
* Scrollbars, status bar, dialogs already follow Notepad++'s own dark theme.

## Notes on method
* No Windows VM was used for this work (the available VM is owned by another agent and
  cannot be duplicated: 52 GB image, 18 GB free disk). The contract was taken from
  Notepad++'s own source, which is the authoritative description of what the app expects
  from the Win32 API.
* Patches must not be submitted upstream through this process (per instruction).

arguments.content:
# Notepad++ dark mode on Wine (Wine bug 57555)

Goal: make Notepad++ dark mode work under Wine the way it does on Windows, by patching
Wine. Notepad++ is a pure Win32 application (no frameworks/SDKs/browsers), so the fix is
a generic set of win32u/uxtheme/dwmapi patches — **not** an app hack, and it does not
depend on patches from any other project. Built on a pristine `wine-11.18` tarball from
dl.winehq.org.

## Status: FIXED and verified
| | stock Wine 11.18 | patched Wine 11.18 |
|---|---|---|
| menu bar (dark mode) | `#FFFFFF` light (bug) | `#202020` **dark** |
| popup menus (File ▾) | `#FFFFFF` light | `#202020` **dark**, `#E0E0E0` text, `#454545` hover |
| toolbar / editor | dark | dark |
| light mode | light | light (unchanged) |
| "Follow Windows" mode (registry dark) | dark chrome, light menus | fully dark |

`compare_stock_vs_patched.png` (top = stock, bottom = patched, same UI state:
File menu open in dark mode) — stock shows a light menu bar and a light white
dropdown inside an otherwise dark window; patched shows both drawn dark.

## Root cause
Notepad++ paints its menu bar itself using the undocumented **UAH protocol** that Windows
10 1809+ uses for dark-mode apps: it subclasses the frame window
(`NppBigSwitch.cpp:228`) and only draws in response to `WM_UAHDRAWMENU` (0x0091) /
`WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM` (0x0092) / `WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM` (0x0094)
(`NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210`, `src/full/PowerEditor/src/DarkMode/UAHMenuBar.h`).

Wine 11.18 never sends those messages, and the app's dark-mode signals were dropped:
* `uxtheme` ordinals 133 `AllowDarkModeForWindow`, 135 `SetPreferredAppMode`,
  136 `FlushMenuThemes`, 137 `IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow` were `FIXME("stub")`
  returning `FALSE`/`0` (`dlls/uxtheme/system.c`).
* `dwmapi`'s `DwmSetWindowAttribute` ignored `DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE` (=20), which
  is what Notepad++ uses on Windows 10 2004+ (`NppDarkMode.cpp:4236`; Wine reports build
  19045).
* `dlls/win32u/menu.c` had no dark-mode handling at all (menu bar and popups were drawn
  with system colours).

## The patches (`patches/`, regenerate with `tools/make_patches.sh`)
Apply from the Wine source root with `patch -p1` (verified to apply cleanly on pristine
wine-11.18 and to reproduce the tested tree byte-for-byte):

1. `0001-win32u-Send-UAH-menu-bar-messages.patch`
   `NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp()` now detects dark-mode windows, sends `WM_UAHINITMENU` +
   `WM_UAHDRAWMENU` + one `WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM` per item and skips the default drawing,
   so the application paints its own dark menu bar (like Windows 1809+).
   It also draws popup menus dark (background/text/hover/separators/frame) when the
   owner window uses dark mode. Dark mode is read from the `__wine_dark_mode` window
   property (1 = dark, 2 = explicitly light, absent = unset).
2. `0002-uxtheme-Implement-dark-mode-entry-points.patch`
   `AllowDarkModeForWindow` / `IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow` set/read that property instead
   of reporting failure; `SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark)` marks the existing windows of
   the process; `FlushMenuThemes` / `RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState` are no-ops.
3. `0003-dwmapi-Implement-immersive-dark-mode.patch`
   `DwmSetWindowAttribute` / `DwmGetWindowAttribute` implement
   `DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE` by storing/reading the same property, so the
   documented API Notepad++ uses on modern Windows actually works.

All three are generic Win32 behaviour fixes (any dark-mode application benefits);
**no patch is Notepad++-specific**, so `patches/app-specific/npp/` contains only a note.

## Building
```sh
cd wine-build
../wine-src/configure --enable-archs=x86_64   # already configured
./config.status && make -j$(nproc)
```
The build is x86_64-only, so it needs its own prefix (no syswow64):
```sh
DISPLAY=:99 WINEPREFIX=$PWD/prefix-build $PWD/wine-build/wine wineboot -i
```
Wine build gotchas hit while doing this (see STATE.md for details):
* `win32u` is a dual module: the real implementation lives in the unix library
  `win32u.so`; new sources need `#pragma makedep unix`.
* Unix-side wide string literals must be `WCHAR` char arrays, not `L"..."`.
* Adding new win32u syscalls also requires regenerating the checked-in table
  `dlls/win32u/win32syscalls.h` — avoided entirely by using window properties.

## Verifying
```sh
python3 tools/npp_dark_test.py --wine $PWD/wine-build/wine \
        --prefix $PWD/prefix-build --mode dark            # -> OK (dark mode fully applied)
python3 tools/npp_dark_test.py --wine /opt/wine-staging/bin/wine \
        --dllpath /opt/wine-staging/lib/wine --prefix $PWD/prefix --mode dark
                                                          # -> BUG (chrome dark, menu bar light)
```
Screenshots: `compare_stock_vs_patched.png`, `shot_final_patched.png`,
`shot_popup_dark3.png` (dark popup), `shot_final_stock.png` (stock bug),
`compare_light_vs_dark.png` (first reproduction).

Probes used to characterise the APIs: `probe.exe` (uxtheme ordinals + UAH delivery),
`probe2.exe` (theme `Menu`/`MENU_BARITEM` availability), `probe3.exe` (registry /
high-contrast / version checks).

## Known remaining differences vs Windows
* Menu popup scroll arrows and check-mark bitmaps still use system colours (rare in
  Notepad++ menus).
* Caption/title-bar darkening is not applicable: Wine has no DWM compositor and the
  decorations come from the X11 window manager; the DWM attribute is stored but unused.
* Wine has no dark Win32 scrollbars (Notepad++'s `OpenNcThemeData` hooking trick).

## Method notes
* No Windows VM was used (the available VM belongs to another agent and cannot be
  duplicated safely: 52 GB image vs 18 GB free disk). The contract was taken from
  Notepad++'s own source, which is the authoritative statement of what the app expects.
* Patches are not to be submitted upstream through this process (per instruction).
