# STATE — Wine patches to make Notepad++ dark mode run like Windows

Last updated: 2026-10-04 (session 1)
Working dir: /home/asdf/projects/npp-darkmode-wine

## MISSION
Make Notepad++ dark mode (esp. menu bar) work under Wine exactly as on Windows,
by producing Wine patches (uxtheme + win32u). Verify against a Windows VM.
Do NOT submit upstream (LLM rule). Working dir must contain ALL patches used;
app-exclusive patches go in `patches/app-specific/npp/`.

## BUG
Wine bug 57555 ("Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark mode is not fully applied", UNCONFIRMED).
Wine 10.0-rc2 report. Repro: NPP > Settings > Preferences > Dark Mode > "Dark mode".
Menu bar stays light (pure #FFFFFF) while editor/toolbar go dark.

## REPRODUCED (session 1)
- NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64 (latest 2026-09-24) + Wine 11.18 Staging (/opt/wine-staging).
- Pixel proof: menu row (255,255,255) in BOTH light and dark; toolbar/editor (32,32,32)/(63,63,63).
- Artifacts: shot_final_dark.png, compare_light_vs_dark.png, shot_prefs_dark.png,
  probe.c/.exe, src/, menu.c (upstream 11.18 win32u/menu.c), bug-57555.xml.

## ROOT CAUSE (evidence-backed)
- NPP darkens the menu bar ONLY via the undocumented UAH protocol:
  wndproc subclass handles WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x0091) / WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x0092)
  (src/NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210, UAHMenuBar.h; structs UAHMENU/UAHDRAWMENUITEM/
   UAHMENUITEM/UAHMENUITEMMETRICS).
- NPP enables it via uxtheme ordinals: 133 AllowDarkModeForWindow,
  135 SetPreferredAppMode (>=18362), 136 FlushMenuThemes, 137 IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow,
  104 RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState, 49 OpenNcThemeData  (src/DarkMode.cpp:284-333).
  `AllowDarkModeForApp(allow)` -> SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark=2) (src/DarkMode.cpp:42-75).
  `SetDarkMode()` -> AllowDarkModeForApp(useDark) + FlushMenuThemes().
- Probe under Wine 11.18: all those ordinals resolve (so NPP g_darkModeSupported=TRUE),
  BUT: AllowDarkModeForWindow -> FALSE, IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow -> FALSE,
  SetPreferredAppMode -> 0, and **zero** UAH messages ever delivered.
- Wine 11.18 source: dlls/uxtheme/system.c -> those are `FIXME("stub")`.
  dlls/win32u/menu.c has NO dark/UAH handling; include/winuser.h lacks WM_UAH*.
- Wine reports 10.0 build 19045 (passes NPP's CheckBuildNumber; >=19041 so NPP's
  setDarkTitleBar takes the DwmSetWindowAttribute path, and dark forcing comes from
  SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark)).

## DESIGN (current)
1. win32u: new per-process dark-mode state + entry points:
   NtUserSetPreferredAppMode(int)->prev, NtUserAllowDarkModeForWindow(HWND,BOOL)->BOOL,
   NtUserIsDarkModeAllowedForWindow(HWND)->BOOL, NtUserFlushMenuThemes().
   Mode semantics: Default=0, AllowDark=1, ForceDark=2, ForceLight=3.
   Dark for window = (mode==ForceDark) || (mode==AllowDark && per-window flag).
2. uxtheme/system.c: ordinals 133/135/136/137/104 forward to the win32u functions
   (spec: wire via win32u.NtUser* forwarding).
3. win32u/menu.c NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp(): when dark allowed for hwnd ->
   send WM_UAHINITMENU (0x93); send WM_UAHDRAWMENU (0x91) with UAHMENU{hmenu,hdc,flags};
   per item send WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM (0x92) with UAHDRAWMENUITEM{dis,um,umi};
   skip default bar background + default item drawing when app handles it.
   Also WM_UAHMEASUREMENUITEM (0x94) in calc_menu_bar_size per bar item.
   Layer sizes: UAHMENUITEMMETRICS union rgsizeBar[2]{cx,cy}/rgsizePopup[4]{cx,cy}.
4. Popups (WM_UAHNCPAINTMENUPOPUP 0x95) — phase 2 if needed.

## PATHS / ASSETS
- wine-src/           pristine wine-11.18 (dl.winehq.org tarball), to be patched+built.
- patches/            output patch series (git format-patch style). [to create]
- patches/app-specific/npp/   app-exclusive patches. [to create]
- prefix/             NPP test WINEPREFIX (win64).
- npp/                NPP 8.9.8.1 portable x64.
- probe.c/probe.exe   UAH/uxtheme probe harness.
- src/                NPP dark-mode sources (upstream master).
- Xvfb :99            used for NPP runs (started/stopped ad hoc).
- Windows VM: UNAVAILABLE — the win11 libvirt VM is in use by another agent (user
  clarification 2026-10-04). DO NOT touch it. Windows-side oracle = Notepad++ source
  (src/UAHMenuBar.h + NppDarkMode.cpp) which IS the win32 contract spec, plus
  reference UAH implementations. Verification oracle = the app itself under Wine.

## PROGRESS (session 1)
- Pristine wine-11.18 extracted to wine-src/, configured in wine-build/ (--enable-archs=x86_64).
- Patch implemented in wine-src (see patches/ once generated by tools/make_patches.sh):
  1. dlls/win32u/darkmode.c (new): per-process app mode + per-window overrides;
     NtUserSetPreferredAppMode / NtUserAllowDarkModeForWindow /
     NtUserIsDarkModeAllowedForWindow / NtUserFlushMenuThemes.
     Dark for window = ForceDark app mode, or per-window ALLOW; DISALLOW wins.
  2. dlls/win32u/win32u.spec: 4 new -syscall entries (appended at end of file).
  3. dlls/win32u/menu.c: UAH structs + draw_dark_menu_bar(); NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp()
     calls it and skips default drawing when true.
  4. dlls/uxtheme/system.c: ordinals 133/135/136/137 forward to win32u;
     ordinal 104 is a no-op.
  5. uxtheme/Makefile.in IMPORTS += win32u; window.c calls darkmode_remove_window();
     include/ntuser.h prototypes; win32u_private.h externs.
- Pristine copies of every edited file: patches-draft/orig/.
- Verified beforehand: OpenThemeData("Menu") + DrawThemeTextEx(MENU_BARITEM) already
  work in wine 11.18 (probe2.exe), so theming is NOT the blocker.
- Windows VM: SKIPPED per user (in use by another agent; 52GB image vs 18GB free).
  Oracle = Notepad++ source (src/UAHMenuBar.h, src/NppDarkMode.cpp). No app-exclusive
  patch is currently expected: NPP uses the generic undocumented API set.

## BUILD ARCH NOTES (learned the hard way)
- win32u is a dual module: `MODULE = win32u.dll` + `UNIXLIB = win32u.so`.
  The *real* implementations (menu.c, window.c, defwnd.c, ...) are compiled into the
  **unix** library win32u.so; the PE win32u.dll only links main.c + generated syscall
  thunks. So new win32u source files MUST carry `#pragma makedep unix`, otherwise
  makedep builds them for the PE side and they fail on wine/gdi_driver.h
  ("can only be used on the Unix side").
- New win32u source: add to SOURCES in dlls/win32u/Makefile.in AND put
  `#pragma makedep unix` at the top of the file. Include order must start with
  ntgdi_private.h (which pulls win32u_private.h) before ntuser_private.h.
- After Makefile.in changes: run ./config.status then make (make caches Makefiles).
- dlls/win32u/x86_64-windows/win32u.dll links ONLY main.o -> implementations are unix-side.
- Test harness: tools/npp_dark_test.py samples median of blank menu-bar/toolbar bands
  (x 0.60-0.90) after parking the pointer at (1500,980); stock wine correctly => BUG.

## DESIGN v2 (current, after v1 was abandoned)
v1 added 4 new win32u syscalls (darkmode.c). ABANDONED: adding win32u syscalls also
requires updating the checked-in generated table dlls/win32u/win32syscalls.h
("Automatically generated by tools/make_specfiles", 3080 SYSCALL_ENTRY lines); the PE
win32u.dll link then fails with undefined references to the new exports. All v1 changes
were reverted (files restored from patches-draft/orig; darkmode.c deleted).

v2 uses existing, documented mechanisms and needs no new syscalls:
- Per-window state in a window property `__wine_dark_mode` (1 = dark, 2 = explicitly
  light, absent = unset). Written via SetPropW (user32), read in win32u via NtUserGetProp.
- dlls/dwmapi/dwmapi_main.c: DwmSetWindowAttribute/DwmGetWindowAttribute implement
  DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE (=20) by setting/reading that property. Notepad++ 8.9.8.1
  uses exactly this on build >= 19041 (NppDarkMode.cpp:4236, Windows reports 19045).
- dlls/uxtheme/system.c: AllowDarkModeForWindow/IsDarkModeAllowedForWindow use the
  property; SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark) marks existing windows of the process via
  EnumWindows; FlushMenuThemes/RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState are no-ops.
- dlls/win32u/menu.c: is_dark_mode_allowed_for_window() = property == 1; when true,
  NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp() sends WM_UAHINITMENU + WM_UAHDRAWMENU + per-item
  WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM and skips the default drawing.
Patch set: 3 patches (menu.c, system.c, dwmapi_main.c). No app-exclusive patches.
NPP call chain: NppBigSwitch.cpp:228 installs the menu-bar subclass on WM_CREATE;
NppDarkMode.cpp:4236 sets the DWM attribute; 4154-4210 handles the UAH messages.

## NEXT ACTIONS
1. Finish the wine build (wine-build, `make -j20`), fix any compile errors in the patch.
2. Run tools/npp_dark_test.py against the built wine: expect "OK (dark mode fully applied)".
3. Compare with /opt/wine-staging (stock 11.18) which must still show the bug.
4. Regenerate patches/ via tools/make_patches.sh; verify `patch -p1` applies to pristine.
5. If the bar stays light: debug with WINEDEBUG=+darkmode,+message, check that
   SetPreferredAppMode(ForceDark) arrives and that UAH messages reach NPP's subclass.

## RULES FROM USER
- Reward over cost; saturate CPU but never OOM (check mem/disk first).
- ~10 or fewer parallel subagents; store state for compaction.
- VNC display for autonomous GUI interaction.
- Use WineHQ wiki building instructions; Wine best practices; no upstream submission.
- If fix is config/fonts not patches -> document reproducible fix.
- If app can't run / can't be licensed due to missing kernel APIs -> document and stop.

  EnumWindows; FlushMenuThemes/RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState are no-ops.
- dlls/win32u/menu.c: is_dark_mode_allowed_for_window() = property == 1; when true,
  NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp() sends WM_UAHINITMENU + WM_UAHDRAWMENU + per-item
  WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM and skips the default drawing.

NPP call chain: NppBigSwitch.cpp:228 installs the menu-bar subclass on WM_CREATE;
NppDarkMode.cpp:4236 sets the DWM attribute; 4154-4210 handles the UAH messages.

  bitmaps, caption darkening (no DWM in Wine), dark Win32 scrollbars.

- Reward over cost; saturate CPU but never OOM (check mem/disk first).
- ~10 or fewer parallel subagents; store state for compaction.

content.text:
✅ **Fixed and verified** in `/home/asdf/projects/npp-darkmode-wine`.

## A/B result (same harness, dark mode)
| | stock Wine 11.18 | patched Wine 11.18 |
|---|---|---|
| menu bar | `(255,255,255)` → `BUG` | `(32,32,32)` → **`OK`** |
| popup menus (File ▾) | `(255,255,255)` white | `(32,32,32)` dark, `#E0E0E0` text, `#454545` hover |
| light mode | light | light (unchanged) |
| Follow-Windows | menus light | fully dark |

`compare_stock_vs_patched.png` — top = stock (light menu bar *and* white dropdown inside an otherwise dark window), bottom = patched. Build: `wine-11.18`, pristine dl.winehq.org tarball, `--enable-archs=x86_64`.

## What was actually wrong
Notepad++ paints its own menu bar via Windows' undocumented **UAH protocol** — it subclasses the frame on `WM_CREATE` (`NppBigSwitch.cpp:228`) and only draws on `WM_UAHDRAWMENU`/`WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM` (`NppDarkMode.cpp:4154-4210`). Wine never sent those and dropped the app's dark-mode signals:
- uxtheme ordinals 133/135/136/137 = `FIXME("stub")` returning FALSE (`dlls/uxtheme/system.c`)
- `DwmSetWindowAttribute` ignored `DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE` (20) — the path NPP takes on build ≥19041 (`NppDarkMode.cpp:4236`)
- `dlls/win32u/menu.c` had zero dark-mode handling

## Patches (`patches/`, 400 diff lines, 3 files)
1. **`0001-win32u-Send-UAH-menu-bar-messages.patch`** — `NtUserDrawMenuBarTemp()` sends `WM_UAHINITMENU`+`WM_UAHDRAWMENU`+per-item `WM_UAHDRAWMENUITEM` and skips default drawing for dark windows; popups drawn dark too. State = window property `__wine_dark_mode`.
2. **`0002-uxtheme-Implement-dark-mode-entry-points.patch`** — 133/137 read/write that property; 135 (`ForceDark`) marks existing process windows; 136 clears.
3. **`0003-dwmapi-Implement-immersive-dark-mode.patch`** — `DwmSet/GetWindowAttribute` handle attribute 20.

Verified: all three apply cleanly to pristine wine-11.18 and reproduce the tested tree byte-for-byte. **No patch is app-specific** → `patches/app-specific/npp/` documents that it is intentionally empty.

## Notable build gotchas (documented in `STATE.md`)
- `win32u` is a dual module — real code lives in the unix `win32u.so`; new sources need `#pragma makedep unix`.
- Unix-side wide literals must be `WCHAR` char arrays, not `L"..."`.
- Adding new win32u syscalls requires regenerating the checked-in `win32syscalls.h` (PE link fails otherwise) — avoided by using window properties.
- x86_64-only build needs its own prefix; a stale wineserver from another wine build blocks it (harness now shuts it down gracefully).

## Remaining cosmetic differences
Popup scroll arrows/check bitmaps still system-coloured; caption darkening N/A (no DWM); no dark Win32 scrollbars.

**No Windows VM was used** (owned by another agent, 52 GB image vs 18 GB free) — the contract came from Notepad++'s source, which fully specifies what the app expects.
